note: From the description of the new species in Constantino 1991 (Goeldiana Zoologia 7); the original records the alate as ALATES - Unknown. Ecological record: found in fairly sound wood on the ground surface of primary terra firme forest.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The left side of the postclypeus bears a conspicuous spine-like projection directed forwards. Only 3 other species are known to have this projection: N. araguaia, N. angusticeps and N. parvus. This species is closest to N. araguaia, from which it differs in the larger body, proportionally longer head, more curved mandibles in lateral view, distinctly trilobed and broader labrum, and smaller and more upwardly directed postclypeal projection of that species; N. angusticeps is larger, with a proportionally longer head and a smaller postclypeal projection; N. parvus is larger, with a much proportionally longer head and a smaller postclypeal projection.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule elongated, the sides parallel, slightly convex. Vertex convex in lateral view. Deformed postclypeus with a conspicuous spine-like projection directed forwards on the left side. Fontanelle small, circular. Antennae 16-segmented, segment 1 largest, segment 2 larger than segment 5, segments 4 and 3 shortest. Anterior margin of the pronotum rounded, with a shallow median notch; posterior margin without a median notch. Posterior margin of the metanotum concave. Left mandible moderately curved, the apex club-shaped. Right mandible with the outer margin nearly straight; lower margin nearly straight in lateral view. Labrum constricted at the base; anterior margin nearly straight. Head with a few setae, more numerous at the sides. Anterior margin of the labrum with 2 setae in the middle. Anterior margin of the postmentum with 2 setae. Pronotal margins with setae. Posterior margins of the mesonotum and metanotum with setae. Legs with scattered hairs and setae. Outer margin of the middle tibia with 1 spine at the middle. Tibial spur formula 3:2:2. Abdominal tergites with short posteriorly directed setae, more numerous near the posterior margin, the posterior margin with a row of a few long erect setae. Sternites with numerous short posteriorly directed setae, the posterior margin with a row of long setae. Head orange yellow. Postclypeus chestnut brown. Pronotum and legs yellow. Abdomen pale yellow. Measurements (5 soldiers from three colonies, mm): head lateral length 2.05—2.11; maximum head width 1.08—1.11; maximum head height (excluding postmentum) 0.86—0.89; left mandible length 1.80; maximum pronotal width 0.69—0.72; hind tibia length 0.78—0.80.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head round; postclypeus moderately inflated; abdomen elongated. Head yellowish white; legs and abdomen nearly white. Vertex with 6 setae; postclypeus without hairs or setae; apex of the labrum with 4 hairs. Pronotum with numerous short to long setae. Abdominal tergites with scattered hairs and short setae; sternites hairy on the surface, the posterior margin with a row of long setae. Legs with scattered hairs and setae; outer margin of the middle tibia with 1 spine, situated distally. Mandibles as in Fig. 4.
